title: Controller-only reseed canonical history validation
finding: Controller snapshot integrity hashes do not prove controller progress matches canonical history. Before this fix, a valid Store snapshot with a modified seen count could be reseeded and published.
implementation: BranchingModel.set_random_stream validates controller progress by replaying accepted canonical history before changing stream_key/next_draw.

Plain sampled controllers use PlainSamplingSession.restore; grammar controllers restore through the server-owned GrammarEngine; legacy greedy controllers are reconstructed and consumed against the canonical suffix.
Coordinator carries the startup GrammarRegistry only for grammar-bound reseed and preserves existing generic model signatures for plain reseed.
CowAdapter forwards its configured server-owned registry to reseed.

behavioral_red.failure: IntegrityError not raised for a checksum-valid canonical snapshot whose seen count disagreed with token history.

regression_details: Plain FlowModel/coordinator route: valid reseed is a positive control; checksum-valid wrong seen count is rejected with unchanged head, no receipt, and unchanged forward/consumed work counters.

Real BranchingModel + real GrammarRegistry + CPU GrammarEngine route: valid reseed preserves grammar state, accepted count, and ambiguous stop prefix; a valid but wrong grammar state and a valid but wrong stop matcher state are rejected before branch mutation.
A grammar-bound reseed without the server registry fails closed.
preserved_attempts: Preserve red-run-v1 through red-run-v7; v7 is the behavioral red. Early staging/import attempts are setup failures.
Preserve runs/regressions-v1 and regressions-v3 failed attempts; regressions-v4 is the final 38-test green run.
Preserve runs/g0-v1 failed path invocation and g0-v2/v3 completed G0 invocations; g0-v3 is current source.
limits: CPU synthetic backend and FlowModel tests only; no native/GPU qualification.
G0 verifier was run with --no-write; its complete terminal output is retained in the external run directory.
